title: A Merry Little Turn Up Girls Day!
seo_title: Girls Day Christmas Party & Craft in Joplin, MO
description: This annual Christmas party includes a paint-by-numbers snowman canvas craft and a small gift exchange, and you can do either, both, or just socialize. The $15 kit includes a frame, numbered canvas, brushes, and numbered paints, and reserving a spot ahead of time is advised; bring a small wrapped gift under $25 for the exchange, and treats are provided. It is for girls and women, with no painting experience needed, on Saturday, December 5, 2026, 1:00 PM to 3:00 PM at Every BODY Fitness, 2639 E 32nd St, Suite T, Joplin, MO.
